|game_text=FRONT - Hidden Base (V): Deploy a planet system (with Rebel Hidden Landing Site there) and Uncharted Settlements. Choose: Rebel/Rebel starship, Alien/Independent starship, or Republic/Republic starship. For remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except vehicles, Jedi Masters, and the pair you chose. Once per turn, may Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle a battleground system. While this side up, once per turn, may Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle a Rebel Cell site or a character (of ability-2 or -3) to a Rebel Cell site. Flip this card if you occupy three Rebel Cell sites (and opponent controls no Rebel Cell sites). BACK - Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V): While this side up, your Force drains are +1 at each battleground system. At Rebel Cell sites, sectors and each battleground system: your characters of ability < 4, Rebel artillery weapons, and starships are immune to attrition < 4 (or add 2 to immunity). Koensayr Manufacturing and Incom Corporation instead affect all your non-unique starships (except squadrons and corvettes). Once per turn, if you just won a battle against an Imperial or Imperial starship, may Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle any one card. Flip this card if opponent controls two Rebel Cell sites.
|game_text_note=Game text transcribed from VirtualCards15.pdf slip (local PDF; CDN Sources). Official text as of March 21, 2008. Cover has no separate ICON KEY panel - A/C/S and up/down-triangle Reserve Deck phrases expanded per standard Virtual ICON KEY (A=Immune to Alter; C=Immune to Control; S=Immune to Sense; up-triangle = Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; down-triangle = Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; X/pilot-power = Adds X to power of anything he/she pilots). Other slip icons named when clear (Episode I, Rebel, permanent weapon/pilot, ship-docking, set symbols, Force icons). Uniqueness bullet shown as (*). Where the slip footer Decipher base differs from the Virtual title, base is noted. Down-triangles expanded. Rebel / Independent / Republic icons on choose-pair line named. Objective #12 both faces.
